title: Floor Drops
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic |image=Mudworm.png }} '''Floor Drops''' can appear on the {{Zone|Moonglade Marsh}}, {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}} and {{Zone|Critter Safari}}. == Usage == === Moonglade Marsh === '''Floor Drops''' can appear on [[Grass Block]]s around the {{Zone|Moonglade Marsh}}. Clicking on a '''Floor Drop''' grants one of the following rewards:{{Cite Discord|staff=y|url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1534704840276447414|user=mrkeith|date=8/5/26, 6:24 PM (EST)|text= 
TYPE | WEIGHT
---
Mudworm | 35
50x Fig Log | 25
100x Fig Log | 10
40x Mangrove Log | 25
80x Mangrove Log | 10
Invisibug | 1
}} {| class="wikitable ct" |- ! Reward !! Weight !! Clicking on a '''Floor Drops''' grants one of the following rewards:{{Cite Discord|staff=y|url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1549120383213506621|user=mrkeith|date=9/14/26, 1:11 PM (EST)|text= 
Item | Weight
---
Dung Beetle Shard | 200
Desert Whispers 250x | 100
Desert Whispers 500x | 50
Helix Log 32x | 100
Helix Log 64x | 50
}} {| class="wikitable ct" |- ! Reward !! Weight !! Chance |- | {{Item|Helix Log|32}} || {{Aqua|100}} || {{Chance|20%|1|5|rolls}} |- | {{Item|Helix Log|64}} || {{Aqua|50}} || {{Chance|10%|1|10|rolls}} |- | {{Desert Whispers|250}} || {{Aqua|100}} || {{Chance|20%|1|5|rolls}} |- | {{Desert Whispers|500}} || {{Aqua|50}} || {{Chance|10%|1|10|rolls}} |- | {{Item|Dung Beetle Shard|1}} || {{Aqua|200}} || {{Chance|40%|1|2.5|rolls}} |} The rewards granted can be affected by {{Stat|Foraging Fortune}} and {{Stat|hf}}. === Critter Safari === On the Critter Safari, '''Floor Drops''' have a chance to spawn in preset locations in all four biomes, with each biome having its own biome specific shard, and some biomes having biome specific items as well.
